summary: Verified image loading fix for Lloyd Law Firm site. All 5 local images serve HTTP 200 with content-type image/png. Rendered DOM inspection on Home, About, Blog listing, and Blog detail pages confirms all elements load (naturalWidth > 0) and no src references customer-assets.emergentagent.com. Two blog thumbnails still use images.unsplash.com (unchanged, and they loaded OK).

issues: Local PNGs are very large (logo.png ~2.2MB, attorney-hero ~1.9MB, blog-family-consultation ~2.2MB). Consider compressing/using WebP or serving responsive sizes to improve LCP and mobile performance.

action_items: Optional: compress /app/frontend/public/images/*.png (currently 1-2.2 MB each) to reduce page weight.
critical_code_review_comments: Image assets are shipped uncompressed at multi-MB sizes; consider optimization step or WebP conversion.
Two blog cards still rely on external images.unsplash.com URLs (mock.js) - same class of risk as previous customer-assets issue if the CDN is blocked in a client environment.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug verified fixed. Home/About/Blog/Blog-detail all render images from /images/*.png with naturalWidth>0. No customer-assets.emergentagent references remain in /app/frontend/src or /app/frontend/public. Only remaining external image references are images.unsplash.com in 2 blog posts (loaded fine during test).
rca of the issue: Previously images were referenced from https://customer-assets.emergentagent.com/... which was blocked in the user's browser environment. Fix: downloaded all 5 images to /app/frontend/public/images/ and updated /app/frontend/src/mock.js to point to /images/*.png. Verified via curl (HTTP 200, image/png) and Playwright DOM inspection (all imgs complete, naturalWidth>0).
